001package models;
002import java.io.Serializable;
003import java.time.LocalDateTime;
004
005/** Inbox message with sender, body, and timestamp. */
006public class Message implements Serializable {
007    private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
008
009    private String sender;
010    private String text;
011    private LocalDateTime date;
012
013    public Message(String sender, String text) {
014        this.sender = sender;
015        this.text = text;
016        this.date = LocalDateTime.now();
017    }
018    @Override
019    public String toString() {
020        return "[" + date + "] " + sender + ": " + text;
021    }
022}
